study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Hua et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2025
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Adjustment of Regional Cortical Thickness Measures for Global Cortical Thickness Obscures Deficits Across the Schizophrenia Spectrum: A Cautionary Note About Normative Modeling of Brain Imaging Data

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study utilized ordinary least squares regression (OLSR) to model the effects of age, gender, and site in healthy controls to derive predicted regional thickness values and subsequent adjusted z-scores.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Hua2025.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / z -Scoring Normalization
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: ROI thicknesses were regressed on age, gender, and site (only study 2 included site) in HCs to model the effects of normal aging, gender, and site. Resulting parameter estimates were used to derive predicted ROI values for each participant, irrespective of group

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study analyzed regional cortical thickness (34 ROIs based on the Desikan-Killiany atlas) derived from FreeSurfer.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Hua2025.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / MRI Processing
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: In this article, we focused on cortical thickness and the effect of global adjustment. Global mean cortical thickness and ROI thicknesses (22) were computed using FreeSurfer

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.answer: Age-related: Age; Demographics: Sex; Site/Scanner: Site; Global brain measures: Mean CT; Global brain measures: ICV/TIV
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age, gender, and site were used in the baseline normative model. Global mean cortical thickness was used as an explanatory variable in the 'with global thickness' model. Intracranial volume (ICV) was used as an explanatory variable in sensitivity analyses.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Age, gender, site (for Study 2), and global thickness (for global thickness model) effects for each ROI were modeled in the HC group using this formula: y i = β 0+ β 1*age + β 2*gender + β 3*site (for Study 2) + β 4*global thickness (for global thickness model) + e i .
